title: Detects whether a Solana wallet routes through Jito, Nozomi, BloXroute, ZeroSlot
description: Detects whether a Solana wallet routes through Jito, Nozomi, BloXroute, ZeroSlot, BlockRazor, NextBlock, Astralane, or Helius Sender. Returns organic-vs-private-routing execution evidence, tip-stack counts, service-quarantine status, and coverage warnings so agents can filter bot-like or infrastructure wallets before deeper Solana wallet forensics.
